disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinical cohort from the ABIDE data set applied to hierarchical Bayesian normative models
disorder-name.supporting_text: "we applied the hierarchical Bayesian models to 482 individuals with autism from the same data set"
disorder-name.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / Data / 3.1.1 ABIDE data set, L125

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABIDE (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange) consortium dataset; referenced as Di Martino et al., 2014, which corresponds to ABIDE-I (539 ASD + 573 controls = 1112 participants)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The ABIDE consortium (http://preprocessed-connectomesproject.org/abide/) was founded to facilitate research and collaboration on autism spectrum disorders by data aggregation and sharing. The consortium provides a publicly available structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data set and corresponding phenotypic information of 539 individuals with autism spectrum disorder and 573 age-matched typical controls."
dataset-of-origin.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / Data / 3.1.1 ABIDE data set, L125

age.detail: Mean and SD are weighted/pooled from sex-stratified values (Male: M=16.9, SD=6.5, n=430; Female: M=15.1, SD=5.8, n=52). Weighted mean = (430×16.9 + 52×15.1)/482 = 16.71; Pooled SD = sqrt(((429×6.5² + 51×5.8²)/481)) = 6.42
age.supporting_text: "Autism sample : Age male subjects: M = 16.9., SD = 6.5. Age female subjects: M = 15.1, SD = 5.8., range = 8-39;"

sex.detail: 430 males explicitly reported; female n=52 estimated by subtracting male n from total N (482 − 430 = 52)
sex.supporting_text: "we applied the hierarchical Bayesian models to 482 individuals with autism from the same data set, out of which 430 were male."
sex.location: Bayer2022.pdf.md: Methods / Data / 3.1.1 ABIDE data set, L125
